proposal.hypothesis: Register-caching 8 x and weight values per lane for D=257 eliminates the second global pass, while one 32-thread group per row spreads 64 rows across GPU cores and uses only one simd_sum per row.
One SIMD group per row using runtime-width strided loads and simd_sum avoids threadgroup barriers and shared-memory reduction; re-reading cached x for scaling minimizes latency for 64x257.
